name: DiscoveryModule
description: ESPRack module: LAN device discovery (mDNS, not a mesh network). Browses _esprack._tcp peers (with an HMAC project-key trust tag + manifest-schema compatibility), exposes /api/v1/discovery/peers, and adds a Discovery page. Builds on MdnsModule (the mDNS substrate is part of this feature). Compile-time excludable.
